subject: Expanding Double Brackets

What is the median of the following numbers?

2, \quad 0.2, \quad 0.02, \quad 0.002
\]

student_answer_en: Impossible as you can't have a decimal coordinate

question_en: Which of the following pairs of function machines are correct?
misconception_name: Does not follow the arrows through a function machine, changes the order of the operations asked.

construct: Recognise whether you need to add or subtract linear equations in order to eliminate a variable
question_en:
Tom and Katie are discussing this pair of simultaneous equations: \( \begin{array}{l}3 x-2 y=15 \\ x+2 y=20\end{array} \) Tom says if you add the two equations together you will eliminate a variable

Katie says if you subtract the two equations together you will eliminate a variable

subject: Expanding Single Brackets
